title: A Quiet Shrine
description: A weathered shrine sits at a crossroads, half-swallowed by moss.

choices.label: Pray a moment (heal 10 HP)
choices.resultText: You feel steadier.

choices.label: Keep walking
choices.resultText: You continue on your way.

title: A Desperate Traveler
description: A stranger, gaunt and shaking, begs for help.

choices.label: Share your rations (lose 5 HP)
choices.resultText: It costs you, but they'll live.

choices.label: Take their coin instead (gain 20 gold)
choices.resultText: Not proud, but pragmatic.

title: An Overgrown Library
description: Shelves of rotted books, one still legible.

choices.label: Study the technique (gain a random card)
choices.resultText: You add a new trick to your deck.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.resultText: Some knowledge isn't worth the risk.

title: A Sealed Reliquary
description: A stone case, sealed shut, hums faintly.

choices.label: Force it open (gain a relic)
choices.resultText: Power hums within, now yours.

choices.label: Pay the toll to pass safely (lose 15 gold)
choices.resultText: You leave it undisturbed.

title: A Grasping Shade
description: A translucent hand reaches from the dark, feeling for your belongings.

choices.label: Let it take what it wants (lose a relic)
choices.resultText: Something of yours is gone.

choices.label: Bribe it with gold instead (lose 20 gold)
choices.resultText: It fades, satisfied.

title: The Bone Orchard
description: Trees of fused bone stand in rows, their branches hung with small white fruit.

choices.label: Take one and swallow it (gain 6 max HP)
choices.resultText: It is chalk on the tongue, and then it is strength.

choices.label: Walk the rows and leave
choices.resultText: You do not eat what grows here.

title: A Flooded Crypt
description: Black water fills the stair to the chin. Something gold glints two steps under.

choices.label: Dive for it (lose 8 HP, gain 40 gold)
choices.resultText: You come up shaking, coins clenched in a fist you cannot open.

choices.label: Leave it to the water
choices.resultText: The glint is still there when you look back.

title: The Whetstone Altar
description: A wheel of grey stone, still wet, turning with no hand on it.

choices.label: Sharpen something (upgrade a card of your choice)
Leave the wheel turning
choices.resultText: You keep your edges as they are.

title: The Confessor
description: A figure in a slatted mask waits behind a grille. It does not ask; it simply waits.

choices.label: Confess a weakness (remove a card of your choice)
Say nothing (heal 6 HP)
choices.resultText: The silence is its own kind of rest.

title: An Alchemist's Remains
description: A body slumped over its own workbench, one hand on a flask, the other on a purse.

choices.label: Take the flask (gain a potion)
choices.resultText: Still warm. Still sealed.

choices.label: Take the purse (gain 25 gold)
choices.resultText: Heavier than it looked.

title: The Hollow Bargain
description: A voice with no source offers a trade, and is very clear about the price.

choices.label: Accept (gain a relic, lose 10 max HP)
choices.resultText: The weight arrives. So does the hollow where it was paid from.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.resultText: The voice does not argue. That is the worst of it.

title: A Starving Hound
description: Something too thin to still be walking stands between you and the path, and does not growl.

choices.label: Feed it (lose 6 HP, gain a relic)
choices.resultText: It eats from your hand, then drops something at your feet and is gone.

choices.label: Drive it off (lose 12 HP)
choices.resultText: It goes. It takes a piece of you with it.

title: The Gambler's Skull
description: A skull sits on a flat stone with four knucklebones in its jaw, arranged as if mid-throw.

choices.label: Roll the bones
choices.resultText: The bones settle.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.resultText: The skull keeps its throw.

title: The Mirror Pool
description: Still water that shows you a half-step behind where you are standing.

choices.label: Study the reflection (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: You watch yourself do it better, and learn the difference.

choices.label: Drink (gain 5 max HP, lose 10 gold)
choices.resultText: It tastes of coin. Some of yours is missing.

title: The Hanged Scholar
description: A body in academic robes, hung from a beam, notes still pinned to its sleeves.

choices.label: Cut him down and read the notes (gain a random card)
choices.resultText: His last work is legible, and useful.

choices.label: Take his purse and go (gain 30 gold, lose 3 max HP)
choices.resultText: You do not look up as you leave. Something in you gives anyway.
